scope: General YouTube upload, YPP, privacy, and copyright documentation; account eligibility and country rights separately assessed
method: Use distinct official source families to register labeling, authenticity, privacy and copyright gates; classification illustrations are constrained examples, not individual case decisions or legal advice.

policy_axes.title: Upload disclosure
policy_axes.rule: Disclose meaningful, realistic AI alteration or AI-generated music as central content. Some minor/fantasy/production aid cases are excluded.

policy_axes.title: YPP inauthentic and repetitious material
policy_axes.rule: Substantively repetitive or mass-produced low-originality content can be ineligible regardless of AI assistance; the 2025 rename was described as a clarification.

policy_axes.title: Privacy and likeness
policy_axes.rule: Realistic altered person-likeness may justify privacy complaint review; experimental likeness tool is limited by country, age and identity verification.

policy_axes.title: Copyright ownership and permissions
policy_axes.rule: Jurisdiction-specific protection and permissions require separate evaluation; YouTube may ask further details rather than treating an AI label as proof of title.

illustrative_examples.label: Fantastical non-realistic animation
illustrative_examples.limits: A fictional animation alone does not require an AI label under these examples; other policies still apply.

illustrative_examples.label: AI help with outline, captions or minor edits
illustrative_examples.limits: Assistance does not excuse a separate substantial realistic alteration in the actual upload.

illustrative_examples.label: Real person made to say words they never said
illustrative_examples.limits: May also violate privacy or misinformation rules; disclosure is not immunity.

illustrative_examples.label: Realistic footage of an event that did not happen
illustrative_examples.limits: Realistic depictions may have additional context, safety and misinformation limitations.

illustrative_examples.label: AI-generated music as the main video content
illustrative_examples.limits: Disclosure does not establish composition ownership, music licensing, or YPP approval.

disclosure_process.interface: YouTube Studio upload Attributes > AI use selection
disclosure_process.notice: YouTube may add automatic labels for content using its internal AI tools, verified C2PA metadata, or internal detection; manual review may also fix labels.
